audit_items.proof_trace: PKCE is enforced on every token exchange via two layers: (1) L36 rejects requests missing `codeVerifier`, and (2) `verifyCodeChallenge` at L109-113 computes SHA256(verifier) and compares it to the DB-stored `code_challenge`, using only the DB-stored `code_challenge_method` (not a client-supplied value). The `verifyCodeChallenge` implementation (`oauth.ts:L68-83`) enforces S256-only — any other method returns false — so no bypass via method substitution is possible. No alternative token exchange path exists.
